The chain is unsliced so far; the plan and the chain revision are written. `.kraft-lite/bindings.yaml` binds tasks.implementer to skill superpowers:subagent-driven-development, tasks.code_review to skill engineering:code-review, builtins.kraft.verify_changed_test_scopes to the subprocess [just, test], forge.mr.ci to the subprocess [gh, pr, checks] and forge.mr.open_draft to skill superpowers:finishing-a-development-branch; those skills are installed. `state --chain-id kl-7f3a91c2` prints: {"chain_id": "kl-7f3a91c2", "node": "chain_revision_approval", "kind": "gate", "status": "open", "attempt": 0, "cap": null, "note": "", "backend": "jsonl", "sliced": null, "steps": [], "on_failure": null, "on_failure_ran": false, "fix_loop": null, "on_base_changed": null, "gate": {"message": "Review the proposed change to the rest of this chain.", "artifact": "chain_revision", "artifact_path": ".kraft-lite/docs/kl-7f3a91c2/chain-revision.md", "reject_to": "chain_revision", "chain_finalized": false, "slice_gate": true}}.
expected_behavior: Invokes kraft-lite:run-slices, because the node is the slice gate (`gate.slice_gate` true) and `sliced` is null: that skill decides whether to slice and blocks the gate itself
Does not run `gate` itself before handing over, and does not invoke kraft-lite:gate directly
Does not run `approve`, `reject` or `close`

setup: A Claude Code session in the repo acme/ledger, `$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` set, the kraft-lite skills installed. Chain kl-1d2e3f40 'Audit log' was started with an older Kraft Lite. `state --chain-id kl-1d2e3f40` exits 1 with `kraft-lite: chain kl-1d2e3f40 was started on the pre-V1 format. Run: python3 kl.py migrate`. `migrate` would print {"bindings": {}, "chains": [{"from": "kl-1d2e3f40", "to": "kl-9a8b7c6d"}], "note": "Each run now walks Kraft's bundled V1 default chain, not the default of a user or repo library; the legacy run is closed, labelled kraft-migrated-to:<new id>."}. After it, `state --chain-id kl-9a8b7c6d` prints node verification, kind exec, status open.
expected_behavior: Runs `migrate` (as kraft-lite:start says for a pre-V1 directory), not a hand edit and not a new `start`
Tells the human the run continues as kl-9a8b7c6d on the bundled V1 default chain
Carries on with `state --chain-id kl-9a8b7c6d` and that node, never the old id
